baslik: What Actually Makes a Volcano Explode
aciklama:
A volcano is a bottle of shaken soda the size of a mountain. Here is what makes it blow.

#shorts #science #volcano #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A volcano is a shaken soda bottle that can explode.
When it lets go, rock and ash blast out faster than a jet.
But why do some volcanoes ooze while others explode?
Deep below, molten rock rises with dissolved gas.
As it climbs, the pressure drops and the gas wants out.
Thick, sticky magma traps that gas instead of releasing it.
Pressure builds until the whole mountain gives way at once.
A quiet volcano may simply be building pressure.

vaka.ders: sticky magma explodes; runny lava oozes
vaka.yanilgi: Lava flows are rarely the big killer — explosive eruptions kill mainly through ash, pyroclastic flows and mudflows.
vaka.tartisma: Would you live near a volcano that has been quiet for a century?
